title: fix(components): page:header stops drawing an empty breadcrumb slot; the key is ignored until the spec retires it (objectui#11166)
body:
Fixes #11166
Clause-②: no

Implements the renderer and docs half of triage `5903152845` (ruling RETIRE). The spec half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758; this PR does not depend on it. Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`, branch `claude/issue-11166-page-header-breadcrumb-retire`.

## What changed

- **Renderer.** `PageHeaderRenderer` in `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` no longer reads `breadcrumb`. It drops both empty `data-page-breadcrumb-slot` divs: the record-chip layout's (above `RecordTitleChip`) and the bare layout's (above the title row). An authored `breadcrumb` (`true` or `false`, in `properties` or on the node) renders exactly like an absent key: no slot and no error. ⛔ No trail is drawn in its place.
- **Registration.** `inputs` keeps `{ name: 'breadcrumb', type: 'boolean' }` and adds a description saying the key is ignored. It stays declared while the installed spec (17.4.0) still accepts the key; the measured reasons are in Zone 2 item 2 below. It leaves at the pin bump that brings objectstack#20758's tombstone, when the parity file's forward direction will name it.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` drops the key's prop-table row, the "renders an empty slot element" paragraph, and the layout diagram's `(breadcrumb slot)` line. **One sentence** replaces the paragraph. I chose one sentence over none because the spec still publishes the key as "Show breadcrumb", default `true`, and this page is where an author learns it draws nothing.
- **Declared surface extension: `content/docs/guide/layout.md`.** It is outside the claimed surface, but this change makes it false, so it is a must-fix.
  - Its `page:header` Schema API excerpt listed `breadcrumb?: boolean // default true — the breadcrumb slot above the title`. That line goes.
  - Three callouts called the key "a boolean display toggle (for the slot above the title)". They now say it is a boolean the renderer ignores.
  - Same file, same defect class: the overview bullet "PageHeader - Consistent page headers with title, breadcrumbs, and actions" drops "breadcrumbs". Neither the canonical renderer nor `@object-ui/layout`'s `PageHeader` draws one; the latter's render body has no breadcrumb element.
  - The claim did not check open PRs against this file. Please check for overlap before landing.
- **Changeset.** `'@object-ui/components': patch`, which names the visible spacing shift.

## Zone 2 measurements (base `c2a8d23c6`)

1. **Sites.** All confirmed by content:
   - the read `const breadcrumb = (schema?.breadcrumb ?? schema?.properties?.breadcrumb) !== false;`;
   - the two `{breadcrumb && (...data-page-breadcrumb-slot...)}` blocks;
   - the "breadcrumb/action slots" section comment, now "action slot".

   **Root class strings are byte-unchanged.** The bare root is `flex flex-col gap-2 pb-4 border-b`, and the record root keeps `gap-3 sm:gap-4`. The demo pin `pageheader-with-actions.test.tsx` stays green on `gap-2` / `pb-4` / `border-b`.

   **The rendered spacing does move.** Measured in Chromium 1194 (headless) with plain CSS equal to the Tailwind utilities, not the built stylesheet:

   | Layout | Title offset in the header | Header height |
   |---|---|---|
   | bare | 8px, now 0px | 56px, now 48px |
   | record | 4px, now 0px | 60px, now 56px |

   The empty div was a flex item in the root's `gap-2` column (bare), or carried `mb-1` (record). A header that already set `breadcrumb: false` does not move.
2. **Registration inputs list `breadcrumb`.** ⛔ The parity file `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` is untouched.
   - It has no `page:header.breadcrumb` row. `NO_READ_SITE_TO_PIN` lives in its member-pin ledger, which covers array- and object-armed inputs only, and `breadcrumb` is boolean. So removing the read moves no row, and the file stays green at head.
   - Why the input must stay, measured with a one-off probe (not kept):
     - with the input declared, an authored `breadcrumb: true` draws **zero** manifest diagnostics;
     - with the input filtered out, it draws `unknown-prop`, whose message says page:header has no prop "breadcrumb";
     - the control, the key absent with the input filtered out, draws zero.
   - Dropping the input would also be demanded back by the parity file's reverse direction, which reads every accepted spec key. Covering it needs an `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` entry in that file, which belongs to objectui#11086.
3. **Docs.** The key leaves all three sites. One sentence was chosen (see above).
4. **Existing pins.** None moved.
   - `git grep -n breadcrumb -- '*.test.*'` under `packages/components` and `examples/schema-catalog` hits only `ui:breadcrumb` and config-panel suites.
   - The objectui#11162 demo pins assert the root class strings, which did not change.
   - The `actions-slot` pins are green: the full components suite is below, and the new pin asserts `data-page-actions-slot` in both layouts.

## Tests (all at head `8ef26fe20`, unless marked)

- **New pin: `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-breadcrumb-ignored-11166.test.tsx`.** It mounts through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry, in both layouts.
  - In each layout, three authored spellings are tested: `properties.breadcrumb: true`, `breadcrumb: true` on the node, and `properties.breadcrumb: false`.
  - Each renders no slot and no `breadcrumb` text anywhere in the header, with no `console.error`.
  - Each renders the same header markup as the absent-key CONTROL, with React ids blanked. The control asserts the `h1` and `data-page-actions-slot`, so the test cannot pass on an empty header.
  - Result: `Tests 8 passed (8)`, run at `26bc72b6e`, where `containers.tsx` has the same blob as head.
- **`@object-ui/components` plus `examples/schema-catalog`.** Run as `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/ examples/schema-catalog/ --shard=N/4`, four shards under the verify lock. The unsharded run hit the 560s timeout on the shared box, so it was sharded.

  | Shard | Test files | Tests |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1/4 | 94 passed | 1354 passed, 7 skipped |
  | 2/4 | 94 passed | 1534 passed, 10 skipped |
  | 3/4 | 93 passed | 1796 passed |
  | 4/4 | 92 passed, 1 skipped | 827 passed, 7 skipped |

  That is 374 files, which equals the 376 `*.test.*` files `git ls-files` lists minus two `.snap` files.
- **Cross-package readers: 75 files, 75 passed, 2006 tests.** This covers every test outside those two trees that reads `containers.tsx` or the two edited docs pages from disk, or names `page:header`. That includes:
  - `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, `public-contract` and `component-input-union-specimens`;
  - `widget-dom-leak-sweep`, `block-config*` and `PageBlockInspector.i18n`;
  - the RecordDetailView header suites, `page-breadcrumbs-refusal-8871` and `zod-mirror-parity`;
  - `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types` and `doc-version-claims`.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` exits 0, after `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin.

### Ablation (fix committed first; mutation and restore via `ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP mode)

Each leg re-planted the old read-plus-slot in one layout only.

- **Bare leg: 4 failed, 4 passed.** Exactly the four bare rows went red: the control, both `true` spellings, and `false` because it no longer matches the control.
- **Record leg: 4 failed, 4 passed.** Exactly the four record rows went red.
- **Restore.** After both legs, the blob equals HEAD (`c07608e4cc2a`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status` is clean.

## Gates

**Pass (exit 0):**

- `check:doc-snippets`: 679 of 679 blocks judged, 0 failed. It ran after `turbo run build` over its own `--build-filter` closure (35/35 tasks); the first run exited 2 on unbuilt packages.
- `check:doc-examples`: exited 2 on the first run, then passed after the same build.

**Not governed.** `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the five paths reports NOT GOVERNED. The PR stays draft because it was dispatched.

**NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins`.** Reason: it needs a console bundle (`apps/console/dist/assets`) and exits 2 without one. This diff adds or removes no registration and moves no `sideEffects`. Left to CI.

**ESLint, a proven narrowing of CI's `pnpm lint`:**

- Population, read from eslint's own config: of the five changed files, only the two `.tsx` files match a configuration. For the `.md` / `.mdx` / changeset files eslint reports "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied".
- Count, read from `--format json`: 2 files, 0 errors.
  - The new pin has 0 messages.
  - `containers.tsx` has 97 warnings, identical to base by rule: `no-explicit-any` 89, `only-export-components` 7, `exhaustive-deps` 1. Base was read via `--stdin` at the same path.
- Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- **At the pin bump carrying objectstack#20758's tombstone:**
  - the `breadcrumb` entry in `inputs` must go; the parity file's forward direction will name it;
  - so must the one sentence in each doc page that says "accepts it until objectstack#20758 retires it".
  - Carrier: the objectui spec pin-bump PR.
- **The bare root's `gap-2` now spaces a single child,** the title row, so it is inert. It is kept because the ruling moves no class and the demo pin and docs quote it. Polish; carrier: none.
- **A stale test comment.** In `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-breadcrumbs-refusal-8871.test.ts`, the LIT CONTROL comment calls `.breadcrumb` "the live `page:header` toggle", which is no longer true. The control itself still fires on many other hits, and the test is green. It is an unpublished comment; carrier: none.
- **Triage fact, for objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758's measurement.** Triage says the spec's `nav:breadcrumb` "has no objectui renderer". The parity file's `EXPECTED_WITHOUT_INPUTS` lists `nav:breadcrumb` as "Registered, spec-carried, and deliberately propless". This is a read-only inference; carrier: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758.
- `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`'s example still authors `breadcrumb: true`. That file belongs to objectui#11165 and is left untouched. The value renders without error and is ignored.

## Out-of-scope finding (reported to the seat for filing, class c)

**The Studio page designer still offers a "Show breadcrumb" toggle for `page:header`.**

- The producer is `BLOCK_CONFIG['page:header']` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts`, labelled by `engine.inspector.pageBlock.field.page:header.breadcrumb` (en "Show breadcrumb", zh "显示面包屑").
- It writes `breadcrumb` into stored page metadata, which the renderer now ignores. Once objectstack#20758's tombstone is installed, the platform will refuse the whole node by name.
- That file's own `icon` precedent pin says "A retirement that leaves its producer standing makes the failure worse, not better."
- `block-config.test.ts` pins the field set as `['title', 'subtitle', 'breadcrumb']`.
- It is not fixed here: it adds `packages/app-shell` and i18n to the verification surface, which fails condition ④ of the bounded in-place fix.
